note: India test (from 2026-11-25). Times are Europe/Berlin; India (IST) is UTC+5:30. Before 2026-12-01 slot D is not used because Sattelfest reels go out at 16:30. Each test reel is measured at about 24 h; on evaluate_on the run picks the best slot and the three best variants and stores them in result. From 2026-11-26 the test runs only band variants, because the bands do best on every platform. From 2026-11-27 to 2026-12-01 the band series (see series) runs instead of the test: one ready-made video per day at slot A. The test pauses for these five days; its remaining seven days moved from 11-27..12-03 to 12-02..12-08 and evaluate_on from 12-04 to 12-09. Series reels are measured like all others but do not count in the slot and variant evaluation.

series.name: Bänder-Serie: Blau gegen Orange und das goldene Band
series.note: Five ready-made videos (Studio 3.9, 1080p60, 32 s), rendered and checked on 2026-11-26. They tell one story (score 1:0, 1:1, 1:2; record 1024, then 2048), so they are posted exactly as they are, in this order, one per day. serie.sh fetches the file of a day and checks its sha256. The same video can be rendered again with VARIANT=<variant> node render.mjs (the variant fixes seed and settings).
